stories.headline: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is sworn in as premier of Quebec
stories.summary: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon has been sworn in as the 34th premier of Quebec. He led the Parti Québécois to victory in the province's election on 5 October. He has been the party's leader since 2020.

stories.headline: A North Sea gas field is cleared to start producing
stories.summary: Britain's North Sea Transition Authority has approved production from the Jackdaw gas field, which lies in the central North Sea, east of Aberdeen. The energy secretary, Miatta Fahnbulleh, authorised the authority to grant consent. The operator, Adura, is to begin supplying gas by late October.

stories.headline: Electronic Arts shuts down its Canadian studio BioWare
stories.summary: Electronic Arts has shut down BioWare, the Canadian video game developer it acquired in 2007. The studio was based in Edmonton, Alberta, and was founded in 1995 by three newly graduated medical doctors. It closed on 21 October, as part of a series of layoffs at the publisher.

stories.headline: An eyeless snail turns up in a high Chinese cave
stories.summary: Researchers in China have described a new cave snail, Erhaia dijiang, that has entirely lost its eyes. It was found at an elevation of 2,062 metres, the highest recorded for a cave snail in its family. Only three living adults were located.

sources.excerpt: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is sworn in as the 34th premier of Quebec following the Parti Québécois's victory in the general election.
He has served as the leader of the Parti Québécois since 2020.
On October 5, 2026, St-Pierre Plamondon led his party to victory in the 2026 Quebec election.

Jackdaw gas field is a large offshore natural gas field which lies in Blocks 30/02a, 30/02d and 30/03a in the central North Sea, 240 kilometres (150 mi) east of Aberdeen. It has been owned by Adura, a joint venture between Shell and Equinor, since 2025.

The North Sea Transition Authority (NSTA) of the United Kingdom approves production from the Jackdaw gas field after energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh authorized the NSTA to grant consent, allowing operator Adura to begin supplying gas by late October.

BioWare was a Canadian video game developer based in Edmonton, Alberta. It was founded in 1995 by newly graduated medical doctors Ray Muzyka, Greg Zeschuk and Augustine Yip. The company was acquired by American publisher Electronic Arts in 2007.
On 21 October 2026, the studio was shut down as part of a series of layoffs at Electronic Arts.
Scientists found Erhaia dijiang at an elevation of 2,062 meters, making it the highest-altitude cave snail yet recorded within the family Erhaiidae.
As a true cave-dwelling animal, it has entirely lost its eyes, with the structures normally associated with vision having fully degenerated.
Despite searching the shallow cave waters, researchers located only three living adults and one empty shell.
